name: admin.py
summary: Registers all eight portal models with Django's admin interface, configuring list display, search fields, and filters for News, VolunteerLink, Competition, StudyNote, ProblemReport, PointActivity, PointSubmission, and UserPointProfile.

name: archive_old_media.py
summary: Django management command that locates portal model records older than a configurable number of months, compresses their images using Pillow, and re-saves them to either local storage or Cloudinary to reduce storage footprint.

name: clear_mock_data.py
summary: Django management command that deletes all mock data records from every portal model, cleans up associated media files, and prompts for user confirmation before proceeding.

name: seed_mock_data.py
summary: Django management command that seeds the database with representative sample records for all portal models including news, volunteer links, competitions, study notes, problem reports, and point activities, supporting development and QA workflows.

name: models.py
summary: Defines the eight core Django ORM models for the portal app — News, VolunteerLink, Competition, StudyNote, ProblemReport, PointActivity, PointSubmission, and UserPointProfile — with is_published/is_approved flags, foreign keys to the custom user model, and optional media fields.

name: forms.py
summary: Defines the RegisterForm Django form with email-domain validation, verification-code-based role and grade-level determination, and password strength checking for the accounts app registration flow.

name: urls.py
summary: URL routing configuration for the accounts app, mapping register, login, and logout paths to their respective view functions.

name: views.py
summary: View functions handling user registration (with role and grade assignment via RegisterForm), email/password login with safe next-URL redirect support, and logout for the accounts app.

name: forms.py
summary: Defines all Django ModelForm classes for the portal app — news, volunteer links, competitions, study notes, problem reports, point activities, and point submissions — including custom validation for image uploads, Google Drive URL format, description length, point values, and duplicate submission prevention.

name: urls.py
summary: Maps all URL patterns for the portal app, covering student-facing views for content browsing and form submissions, as well as committee-only management routes for CRUD operations across all content types and the points system.

name: views.py
summary: Implements all 39 view functions for the portal app, providing student-facing content views and a full set of committee management views for news, volunteer links, competitions, study notes, problem reports, and points, all enforced by login_required and a custom committee_required decorator.

name: .env.example
summary: Template for local development environment variables covering Django core settings (SECRET_KEY, DEBUG, ALLOWED_HOSTS, COMMITTEE_VERIFICATION_CODE), optional PostgreSQL/Supabase database URL, and optional Cloudinary media storage credentials.

name: AGENTS.md
summary: One-paragraph warning for AI coding agents that the Next.js version in this project has breaking changes; instructs agents to read the bundled docs in node_modules before generating any Next.js code.

name: CLAUDE.md
summary: Developer reference for Claude AI detailing all management commands, the custom User model using email-based login with student/committee roles, access-control decorators, the five portal models, URL structure, and the full template hierarchy.

name: DEPLOY.md
summary: Step-by-step deployment and update guide for PythonAnywhere hosting, covering initial setup, the code-push-and-reload update cycle, an optional automation script, server-side .env file management, and error-log investigation.

name: FINAL_QA_CHECKLIST.md
summary: Pre-release quality-assurance checklist for SWspace with 13 sections covering project setup, authentication flows, all portal features (news, volunteer links, competitions, study notes, problem reports, points), committee access control, file upload security, and media archiving.

name: README.md
summary: Comprehensive Thai-language project overview for SWspace covering tech stack, local setup steps, test accounts, verification codes, full feature list, URL routes, project structure, a 38-test test-suite guide, mock data management commands, image archiving, and deploy notes.
